Remplace le rendu des chunks du jeu. Les: Replaces the game's chunk rendering. Chunks reload every time this setting changes.
Le jeu d'origine envoie chaque chunk à l: The original game sends each chunk to the graphics card one at a time, and often recomputes what is visible. This renderer groups chunks into regions to draw them in a few calls, builds them on other CPU cores, and does not send what is hidden or out of view. It is based on Celeritas, an open-source project.
Le plein écran devient une fenêtre sans: Fullscreen becomes a frameless window covering the screen: instant alt-tab, with no black screen.

Windows envoie d'ordinaire chaque mouvem: Windows normally sends every mouse movement to the game window, one at a time. With a high polling rate mouse, the game spends its time handling them and FPS drops. Here, a separate task reads the mouse directly at system level, with no acceleration, and adds up the movements on its own. The game asks it for the total once per frame, right before turning the camera: no movement is lost, and the game has no extra work to do.

Une ouverture facile, c'est collé à lui: An easy opening is right on them on a short fall: hit it without waiting.

Un smash raté ne remet pas la chute à zé: A missed smash doesn't reset the fall: keep a wind charge to cushion it.

Prenez la hauteur le premier : celui qui: Take the height first: whoever creates the openings leads the duel.
Ne restez pas à portée quand vous ne pou: Don't stay in range when you can't hit: every hit taken counts.
Relancez le sprint entre deux coups, et: Restart your sprint between two hits, and hit as soon as the bar is full: that's what pushes them back before they answer.
Après votre coup, relâchez l'avant ou re: After your hit, release forward or step back for a moment: don't run into them.
Attendez la barre pleine : un coup trop: Wait for a full bar: a hit too early gives no knockback, and they come back at you.
Frappez dès qu'il revient dans votre por: Hit as soon as they come back into your reach, with a full bar: any later and they hit first.
Après chaque coup, gardez la distance et: After each hit, keep your distance and a full bar to hit again before them.
Quand il enchaîne, sautez au moment du c: When they chain hits, jump as the hit lands and take the lead back instead of soaking it up.
Sautez au moment où son coup arrive : vo: Jump just as their hit arrives: you take less knockback and come back faster.
Entrez dans sa portée au moment où votre: Enter their reach just as your bar is full, to land the first hit.
À portée, déplacez-vous de côté plutôt q: In range, move sideways rather than straight at them.
Passez à la masse dès que l'ouverture se: Switch to the mace as soon as the opening takes shape.
Remettez un totem dans l'autre main dès: Put a totem back in your off hand as soon as the first one pops.
Barre pas rechargée au coup suivant: Bar not recharged for the next hit
La note résume un duel à la masse sur 50: The score sums up a mace duel out of 500. 250 is the average player: above, you played better than them; below, worse. It rises in a straight line: 50 more points are the same progress whether you're at 200 or 400. 500 is rare.
Chaque action du duel (une ouverture, un: Every action in the duel (an opening, a smash, a dodge, a wind charge…) is compared with what an average player gets out of it in the same situation. Better than them, it earns points; worse, it costs points. Landing a hard opening earns a lot, an easy one a little, and missing an easy one costs.
Le détail de chaque famille montre les a: The detail of each family shows the actions that counted most and their points.
La note est faite de vos cinq familles,: The score is made of your five families, which all weigh the same: conversion, smash quality, defense, vertical and horizontal control, resources. It judges only your play: your opponent's strength doesn't come into it.
S'y ajoute un bonus, le bug use, pour le: On top comes a bonus, bug use, for the hardest techniques: it never lowers the score and is shown separately, for example 322 + 20 bug use.
Tout est calculé sur votre PC, à partir: Everything is computed on your PC, from what your game sees during the duel. If duel sharing is on (at the top of this page), duels are sent anonymized to calibrate the score. There is no ranking.
Vert à partir de 290 : un bon duel. Ambr: Green from 290: a good duel. Amber from 235 to 289: around average. Red below 235: a tough duel. Gray: no score. Blue bars are your opponent's.
Un duel commence au premier échange de c: A duel starts at the first exchange of hits with a real player. It ends when one of the two loses their gear at the end of the round. An opponent who leaves the duel counts as a draw: they didn't really fight.
Le mode se reconnaît à l'arme en main :: The mode is recognized by the weapon in hand: as soon as a mace appears in either player's hand, it's a mace duel. A duel where each has only their sword is scored in sword mode (see “Sword mode”). Others are recorded but not scored.
Une opportunité, c'est un moment où un s: An opportunity is a moment when a smash is possible: you are falling at least 1.5 blocks, you are going down, you are above the opponent and less than 3.5 blocks from them horizontally.
Elle est convertie si un coup de masse t: It is converted if a mace hit lands during that moment. The same rules apply to the opponent: their opportunities are the ones you give them.
Un passage de moins de 3 ticks au-dessus: Passing above them for less than 3 ticks without a hit: they're just crossing the zone. And a fall facing their raised shield: the hit couldn't go through, not hitting isn't a miss. Behind their back, however, it is an opportunity, and a hard one.
Le smash ajoute des dégâts selon la haut: The smash adds damage based on fall height: 4 per block for the first 3, 2 per block up to 8, then 1 per block beyond, plus the Density enchantment.
Les dégâts de smash d'un duel comparent: A duel's smash damage compares the sum of bonuses actually dealt with what all the opportunities would have given. Big openings (14 blocks of fall and more) and small ones are counted separately, outside the score.
Exploitez-vous vos ouvertures, compte te: Do you exploit your openings, given their difficulty and value? Each opportunity has a chance of success, the one an average player has in the same situation, and a weight, its possible smash bonus.
La chance baisse quand vous êtes loin de: The chance drops when you're far from them at the opening, when they move fast, when the window is short, when the fall is big (you arrive fast, they have time to reposition) and when you have to get behind their shield.
Chaque ouverture est une action : conver: Each opening is an action: converted, it earns more the lower its chance was; missed, it costs more the higher its chance was. A big fall weighs more than a small one. Doing as an average player does on these same opportunities gives 250.
Les chances sont posées à la main en att: The chances are set by hand until they are learned from duels shared by players.
Pour la monter : ne laissez pas passer l: To raise it: don't let easy openings slip, right on them on a short fall.
Ce que vous tirez de vos gros coups. Pou: What you get out of your big hits. For each smash landed: damage dealt divided by possible damage. Possible: mace fully charged, critical hit, and the fall the hit would have had if you'd waited for your feet to reach their head height.
Deux erreurs y coûtent : frapper trop tô: Two mistakes cost here: hitting too early, with less fall than you could have taken, and hitting undercharged (less base damage, no critical). The charge is the one the game counts on the hit: an attribute swap that keeps the previous weapon's charge counts as a well-charged hit.
La charge de la lance compte aussi : les: The spear's charge counts too: damage at impact speed divided by what the highest speed of the approach allowed.
Aucun smash réussi alors que des ouvertu: No smash landed while openings came up is 0. With no opening at all, there's nothing to judge.
La hauteur elle-même n'y compte pas : el: Height itself doesn't count here: it's already in conversion and control. Ordinary hits earn nothing. An average player gets 63% out of their smash: they nearly always go in sprinting, and sprinting prevents the critical. Every smash above that earns, every smash below costs.
Pour la monter : attendez le bas de la c: To raise it: wait for the bottom of the fall to hit, with a full attack bar and without sprinting.
Empêchez-vous l'adversaire de vous mettr: Do you stop the opponent from landing their big hits, and do you hold the trades? Seven measures: trades (a third), then shield, openings given, vulnerable time, dodging, landing cleanly and recovery after a hit.
Échanges : chaque coup du duel, toutes a: Trades: every hit in the duel, all weapons, earns if landed and costs if taken. That's what separates two players over a long duel, when their success rates look alike.
Bouclier : chaque smash arrêté rapporte: Shield: every smash stopped earns according to its value, ten times more if you were 4 blocks or more above the ground; every smash taken costs. A guard broken by an axe costs as much as an 8-block smash. Staying on the ground with your shield up under them costs a little.
Ouvertures laissées : l'envers exact de: Openings given: the exact reverse of conversion, on their opportunities. Each dive dodged is judged against its chance of being dodged. Vulnerable time: on the ground while they're above you and in range. Dodging: leaving their zone during their dives. Landing cleanly: fall damage after one of your missed smashes. Recovery: getting clear after a hit taken.
Les dégâts évités, affichés à part, résu: Damage avoided, shown separately, sums up what they could have dealt you and didn't. It doesn't count in the score.
Pour la monter : levez le bouclier quand: To raise it: raise your shield when they fall on you in the air, not permanently on the ground, and don't stay under them.
Vous déplacez-vous pour mettre le coup ?: Do you move to land the hit? The movement achieved is judged, not the technique: a combo that gets you nowhere earns nothing.
L'initiative (un tiers de la famille) :: Initiative (a third of the family): each opening in the duel earns if you created it, and costs if they did. Whoever dominates creates more openings, even if they miss some.
Suivre pendant la chute (35 %) : vos des: Following during the fall (35%): your dives that arrive in range, the distance closed when they flee, and big hits that land first time. Taking the height (20%): climb speed, time to get back above them, height gained by wind charge or by pearl and wind charge combo, and height dominance.
Se placer au sommet (15 %) : être juste: Positioning at the top (15%): being right above them when you start coming down. Moving horizontally (15%): closing speed against their flight, Lunge dashes that put you in range, elytra flights that end in an opportunity. Chaining (15%): a smash followed by a new opportunity without touching the ground, and the time to rebuild after each engagement.
Une armure en netherite ou la protection: Netherite armor or blast protection make you climb less high: the expected height takes it into account. Each dive, climb or chain is compared with what an average player gets out of it.
Pour la monter : suivez-le pendant votre: To raise it: follow them during your fall so the hit lands first time.
Utilisez-vous vos objets au bon moment,: Do you use your items at the right time, for a good reason? Wind charges and pearls (30%), hotbar (20%), food and health (20%), totems (15%), potions (10%), elytra rockets (5%). A part absent from the duel doesn't count.
Chaque charge de vent ou perle doit avoi: Each wind charge or pearl must have a reason: climb to attack, break their smash, flee when you're low or under them, hit them, cancel a fall that was going to hurt, or a pearl that positions you. Without a reason, it's wasted.
Barre d'inventaire : le délai pour avoir: Hotbar: the delay to have the right item in hand when it's needed (the mace at the opening, the wind charge after landing, the apple when you drop below 4 hearts). Golden apple: below 4 hearts or right after a totem. Potions: strength and speed only. Totems: the delay to put one back.
Chaque objet utilisé est comparé à ce qu: Each item used is compared with what an average player gets out of it. Each totem you pop on them earns, each totem lost costs.
Pour la monter : une charge de vent sert: To raise it: a wind charge serves a purpose, not waiting.
Le niveau de votre adversaire, tel qu'on: Your opponent's level, as read from what they did against you: their four measurable families (conversion, smash quality, defense, vertical and horizontal control), judged with the same expectations as yours, then combined like a score. That's what the face-off shows.
It doesn't go into this duel's score. We only see them play against you: their conversion is the reverse of your defense, their defense the reverse of your conversion. This level is therefore largely a mirror of your play; counting it would take away part of what you did well.
Sa force connue avant le duel est la moy: Their known strength before the duel is the average of their level in your previous duels against them, recognized by their account even if they change name. It's pulled toward 250 while you've faced them little: one past duel counts for a third, two for half, eight for four fifths.
Elle n'entre pas dans votre note, qui ne: It doesn't go into your score, which judges only your play. It's kept for the ranking, where beating a strong opponent will count more.
Ses ressources ne sont pas mesurées : se: Their resources aren't measured: their items can't be seen from here. This level only holds on your PC and against you: it's not a ranking.
Premier duel contre lui : sa force n'est: First duel against them: their strength isn't known yet.
Votre jeu seul, sans son niveau :: Your play alone, without their level:
Un bonus pour les techniques les plus du: A bonus for the hardest techniques of mace PvP. It never lowers the score: it adds to it, up to 50 points, and the score stays capped at 500. A failed attempt costs nothing.
La famille de l'attribute swap, où l'on: The attribute swap family, where you switch items within the tick of the hit: cooldown swap and lunge swap, the most common; breach swap, density swap and reach swap. And the tick-perfect techniques: two totems back to back, stun slam and instant pearl catch, the rarest, which earn the most.
Le bonus monte lentement : une technique: The bonus rises slowly: a rare technique landed earns about 5 points, a common one a little over a point, and repeating the same technique earns half as much each time. You need several rare techniques in one duel to approach 20 points.
Une technique ne compte que réussie : le: A technique only counts when successful: the hit confirmed by the server, or the effect achieved. A breach or density swap that carries a smash counts double, a stun slam is worth more depending on the smash that lands, an instant pearl catch more depending on the height gained when it leads to an opportunity.
Passer de l'élytre au plastron en vol n': Switching from elytra to chestplate in flight isn't part of it: it's a simple right click that everyone does.
Ce qu'on voit de ses techniques est affi: What we see of their techniques is shown, never counted: neither in their strength nor in your score.
Les points sont posés au jugé et seront: The points are set by eye and will be adjusted with more duels.
Chaque action est comparée à ce qu'en ti: Each action is compared with what an average player gets out of it in the same situation (their chance, for an opening, a dodge or a dive), in usual gaps between players. A family is the sum of its actions.
Une famille mesurée sur peu de situation: A family measured over few situations is pulled toward the average: 2 more average situations are counted. A single situation therefore counts for a third, and two smashes landed out of two aren't worth the maximum.
Les cinq familles sont moyennées, puis é: The five families are averaged, then widened by 1.37×: an average is tighter than a single family. This widening isn't chosen: it comes from how families rise together among players, measured on shared duels.
Être bon partout est plus rare qu'être b: Being good everywhere is rarer than being good in one family: a very consistent duel can therefore score a bit above its best family. It's the same principle as a total IQ.
La note vaut 250, plus 100 par écart, en: The score is 250, plus 100 per gap, in a straight line, from 0 to 500. Each family bar follows the same scale. Since everything is a sum, the score breaks down exactly into points: each action says what it earned.
Le bonus bug use s'ajoute ensuite à la n: The bug use bonus is then added to the score, never lowering it.
La confiance dit sur combien d'opportuni: Confidence tells how many opportunities the score rests on: n / (n + 5), where n counts both players' opportunities. 5 opportunities give 50%, 20 give 80%.
Un duel n'est pas noté s'il a duré moins: A duel isn't scored if it lasted less than 20 seconds in contact, has fewer than 3 opportunities in total, or isn't with the mace. It stays recorded, but the history only shows scored duels.
La note moyenne de l'historique ne compt: The history's average score only counts scored duels.
La note n'est pas encore calibrée : ce q: The score isn't calibrated yet: what's expected of each action was set from a few duels. Duels shared by players are used to adjust it, and scores may change.
Elle est pensée pour la masse et l'épée: It's designed for mace and sword 1v1. A duel that mixes other items (sword and shield, apples, totems…) is recorded but not scored.
Le ping est affiché, jamais corrigé. Un: Ping is shown, never corrected. High ping can lower conversion.
La note ne regarde que ce que votre jeu: The score only looks at what your game sees: positions, falls, confirmed hits, shield sounds, items in hand. It knows nothing of what happens out of sight.
Les duels enregistrés avant l'arrivée de: Duels recorded before these measures arrived have neither hits stopped by the shield nor the item in hand at the moment of the hit: the parts that depend on them (shield, charge, hotbar, bug use) don't count there.
Les journaux de vos duels sont dans le d: Your duel logs are in the instance folder, under yuyuframe/matches.
Un duel où chacun n'a que son épée en ma: A duel where each player has only their sword in hand (or an empty hand), nothing in the other hand and no item used, is scored in sword mode. Same 500 scale, same principle: each action is compared with what an average player gets out of it.
Quatre familles, qui pèsent autant : com: Four families, which weigh the same: combos, hit quality, defense, placement. No resources: the only item is the sword.
Ouvrez un duel à l'épée pour voir le dét: Open a sword duel to see the detail of each family and of the W-tap.
The score sums up a sword duel out of 500. 250 is the average player: above, you played better than them; below, worse. It rises in a straight line. 500 is rare.
Chaque coup, chaque W-tap, chaque combo: Each hit, each W-tap, each combo is compared with what an average player gets out of it. Better than them, it earns points; worse, it costs points. The detail of each family shows the actions that counted most.
Quatre familles, qui pèsent autant : com: Four families, which weigh the same: combos, hit quality, defense, placement. It judges only your play: your opponent's strength doesn't come into it. No bug use bonus with the sword.
Seul l'épée pure est notée : chacun n'a: Only pure sword is scored: each has only their sword in hand (or an empty hand), nothing in the other hand, and uses no item. A shield, an apple, a totem, a pearl: the duel is recorded but not scored.
Vert à partir de 290, ambre de 235 à 289: Green from 290, amber from 235 to 289, red below. Blue bars are your opponent's.
Un coup porté en sprint, barre pleine, d: A hit landed while sprinting with a full bar gives extra knockback. But right after, the game cuts your sprint and slows you down. For the next hit to push just as hard, you must restart the sprint in between: that's the W-tap. It keeps the opponent at a distance and lets you hit first, again and again.
Pas à la touche, à son effet dans le com: Not by the key, by its effect in the combo. After each of your hits: if your next hit is sprinted and lands before theirs, the W-tap succeeded. If they hit you first, it missed, and that costs.
Un coup suivant sans sprint n'est pas un: A next hit without sprint isn't a W-tap. Nothing within the delay (no next hit): it's a W-tap into nothing, it doesn't count.
Chaque W-tap a une chance de réussite, c: Each W-tap has a chance of success, an average player's: it rises when the hit goes off far from them and when they come back at you fast. An average player lands about one in four: it's the hard move of the mode.
Le détail donne la raison de chaque W-ta: The detail gives the reason for each missed W-tap: ran into the opponent (less than half a block between you, the distance is lost), bar not recharged when they hit, or next hit too late although the bar was full.
Les W-taps de l'adversaire ne se jugent: The opponent's W-taps are only judged with recent logs, which hear the sound of their hits.
Gardez-vous la main ? Trois mesures : ga: Do you keep the lead? Three measures: keeping the lead (35%), the W-tap (40%), combo length (25%).
Garder la main : après chacun de vos cou: Keeping the lead: after each of your hits, the next hit of the duel is still yours. An average player keeps it 57% of the time.
Un combo, ce sont vos coups enchaînés à: A combo is your hits chained less than a second and a half apart, without them hitting you in between. A combo of 4 hits or more is worth the maximum.
Pour la monter : relancez le sprint entr: To raise it: restart your sprint between each hit and hit as soon as the bar is full.
Ce que vaut chacun de vos coups (60 %) e: What each of your hits is worth (60%) and the knockback actually dealt (40%).
Un coup complet a la barre pleine et est: A full hit has a full bar and is critical or sprinted. Full bar with neither, it's worth 0.6. Bar not full, it's worth the share of damage it keeps. An average player is at 70%.
Le recul se lit sur ses déplacements jus: Knockback is read from their movement right after the hit, compared with a sprinted hit's. Their positions arrive slightly late: this measure is approximate.
Pour la monter : ne frappez pas avant qu: To raise it: don't hit before the bar is full.
Cassez-vous ses combos et tenez-vous les: Do you break their combos and hold the trades? Three measures: breaking their combos (30%), trades (40%), jump reset (30%).
Casser : après chacun de ses coups, le c: Breaking: after each of their hits, the next hit is yours. Trades: every hit in the duel earns if landed and costs if taken.
Jump reset : sauter au moment où un coup: Jump reset: jumping the moment a hit lands on you on the ground, which reduces knockback. A hit taken in the air doesn't count: there was no jump possible.
Pour la monter : sautez au moment de son: To raise it: jump the moment of their hit and answer right away.
Tenez-vous la distance ? Deux mesures :: Do you hold the distance? Two measures: the first hit of the trade (75%) and strafing (25%).
Un échange s'arrête après 1 seconde sans: A trade ends after 1 second without a hit. Each player's first hit earns if it's yours, costs if it's theirs: at the edge of reach, you can both hit, and whoever hits first takes the trade.
Strafe : quand il est à moins de 5 blocs: Strafing: when they're less than 5 blocks away, the share of your movement sideways rather than straight at them.
La distance au coup et l'espacement entr: Distance at the hit and spacing between two hits are shown face to face, but don't count: the distance between you is the same for both, they describe the duel, not your play.
Pour la monter : entrez dans sa portée b: To raise it: enter their reach with a full bar to hit first, and circle around them.
En épée, le seul objet est l'épée : il n: With the sword, the only item is the sword: there are no resources to judge. This family only exists with the mace, and the sword score is made only of the other four.
Le niveau de votre adversaire, lu de ce: Your opponent's level, read from what they did against you: their four families, judged with the same expectations as yours. It doesn't go into your score: we only see them play against you, it's partly a mirror of your play.
Sa force connue avant le duel est la moy: Their known strength before the duel is the average of their level in your previous duels against them. It doesn't go into your score; it's kept for the ranking.
Sa barre et son sprint se lisent au son: Their bar and sprint are read from the sound of their hits, only in recent logs. Without them, their W-taps aren't judged.
Chaque action est comparée à ce qu'en ti: Each action is compared with what an average player gets out of it, in usual gaps between players. A family is the sum of its actions.
Une famille mesurée sur peu de coups est: A family measured over few hits is pulled toward the average: 2 more average situations are counted.
Les quatre familles sont moyennées, puis: The four families are averaged, then widened by 1.39×: an average is tighter than a single family. This widening isn't chosen: it comes from how families rise together among players, measured on shared duels.
La note vaut 250, plus 100 par écart, en: The score is 250, plus 100 per gap, in a straight line, from 0 to 500. Each action says what it earned.
La confiance dit sur combien de coups la: Confidence tells how many hits the score rests on: n / (n + 12), where n counts the duel's hits. 12 hits give 50%, 48 give 80%.
Un duel à l'épée se juge à ses coups, pa: A sword duel is judged by its hits, not its length: a clean kill can take ten seconds. It isn't scored if it has fewer than 15 hits in total, or less than 5 seconds in contact.
La note de l'épée a été posée sur peu de: The sword score was set from few duels: what's expected of each action will be adjusted with shared duels, and scores may change.
Le recul et le strafe se lisent dans ses: Knockback and strafing are read from their positions, which arrive late: they're the least precise measures.
C'est peu : la valeur reste proche de la: That's few: the value stays close to the average.
